name: OLIPOP
description: Prebiotic soda brand founded in 2018 by Ben Goodwin and David Lester and based in Oakland, California, making sodas with fiber and prebiotics that support gut health.

evidence.summary: OLIPOP's official affiliate page invites creators with an established community or audience to partner, states the program runs on Impact.com, and publishes a 10% baseline payout (earn up to 20%), a 7-day click referral window and a conversion rate above 12%. The 'up to 20%' wording is a rate tier, not an earnings-cap statement, and no explicit no-cap or unlimited-earnings statement was found, so the commission cap is recorded as unknown.

Beacons Universe reports posts from 2,068 creators all time (150 posted in the last 30 days), 138 sponsored posts mentioning OLIPOP in the last 12 months and 1,384 public posts in the last 12 months, so creator saturation is recorded as high.

Impact's case study says OLIPOP manages nearly 2,000 creator relationships including 82 registered dietitians, created over 1,400 custom codes in three years, requires a minimum of 10,000 followers on at least one platform (with dietitian exceptions), and that the creator affiliate program launched in 2021 and contributes 12% of total sales.

A directory page for the OLIPOP affiliate program publishes partnerships@drinkolipop.com as the contact for program questions ('Apply through Impact.com or email partnerships@drinkolipop.com if you have questions').

reasons.niche_fit: Prebiotic soda is a top food-and-drink creator niche with strong retail and DTC presence.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Nearly 2,000 managed creator relationships, 82 registered dietitians and 1,400+ custom codes documented by Impact.
reasons.compensation: 10% baseline payout on the official page, rising to 20%, with a stated conversion rate above 12%.
reasons.contact_access: Published partnerships email plus a direct Impact application route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is open but generally requires at least 10,000 followers on one platform.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2018, Oakland-based, program managed with Impact and agency GravityFed.

name: Goli Nutrition
description: Gummy supplement brand founded in 2019, known for apple cider vinegar and ashwagandha gummies that are vegan, gluten-free and gelatin-free, sold through its own store, retail and TikTok Shop.

evidence.summary: Goli's official FAQ answers the partner question with 'We do! Please contact us at partners@goli.com if you love our Goli Gummies and want to become part of the Goli extended family!', confirming a partner program with a published contact email. No earnings-cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

BrandChamp's description of the Goli Partners Program (applied for at partners.goli.com by anyone 18+ with a regularly updated social page) says ambassadors start at 10% commission with a 10% follower discount, rising to 20% commission and a 15% follower discount above 200 sales per month, with PayPal payout from a $10 balance. Other listings conflict (Lasso lists up to 18.75%; one review lists a standard 3% affiliate rate and tiered 10-25%), so the 10% Partners starting rate is used and the conflict is flagged here.

Goli's official TikTok Shop reward campaign page addresses brand affiliates directly, publishes affiliate support contact tts@goli.com, and describes bonus rewards on top of commissions for TikTok Shop sales; the bonus thresholds are promotional rewards, not an earnings cap.
JoinBrands' case study says more than 2,000 creators were activated for Goli in Target stores through its managed service, so creator saturation is recorded as high.

reasons.niche_fit: Gummy supplements are a proven, high-volume creator category across TikTok and Instagram.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 2,000+ creators activated in one managed campaign plus an official TikTok Shop affiliate campaign.
reasons.compensation: Partners start at 10% commission per BrandChamp's program description, rising to 20% at volume; listings conflict, so this needs re-confirmation at sign-up.
reasons.contact_access: Two published emails: partners@goli.com for partnerships and tts@goli.com for affiliate support.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Partners application is open to anyone 18+ with a regularly updated social page.
reasons.credibility: B Corp certified brand founded in 2019; HQ and founding details conflict across sources, so credibility is held at 4.

name: Mary Ruth's Organics
description: Vitamin and supplement brand founded in 2014 by MaryRuth Ghiyam with her mother Colleen, selling organic liquid drops, gummies and tonics that are vegan and non-GMO.

evidence.summary: Lasso's MaryRuth's Organics program page states a 10% per-sale commission with a 60-day cookie and a join link to the brand's Refersion portal (maryruthorganics.refersion.com). A second Lasso page for the 'MaryRuth's Preferred' program also states 10% per sale with a ShareASale join link. A further listing claiming up to 26.25% was seen only in search snippets and conflicts, so 10% is recorded. No cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

A Meltwater customer story on MaryRuth's is titled 'Scale Influencer Program to 1000+ Creators' and describes building a team of more than 1,000 content creators, so creator saturation is recorded as high.

Lumanu's case study describes MaryRuth's influencer team partnering with influencers and brand ambassadors and its performance team partnering with UGC creators, and reports the brand passed $100 million in annual sales on creator-driven content.
The brand's official wholesale terms page publishes wholesale@maryruthorganics.com as a contact email; no affiliate-specific email was published on the fetched official pages.

reasons.niche_fit: Vitamins and supplements are a core health-creator niche and the range covers many content angles.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Documented program of 1,000+ creators with dedicated influencer, ambassador and UGC teams.
reasons.compensation: 10% per sale with a 60-day cookie on the Refersion program per Lasso's listing.
reasons.contact_access: Network join links are public, but the only published brand email is the wholesale address.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Multiple live join routes (Refersion, ShareASale Preferred) make entry straightforward.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2014, reported $100M+ annual sales built on creator-driven content.

name: Thrive Market
description: Membership-based online grocery retailer founded in 2014 in Los Angeles, selling organic, non-GMO and eco-friendly products to over 1.7 million members; a certified B Corp.

evidence.summary: Thrive Market's official affiliate page exists ('Affiliates | Thrive Market'); the fetched extraction showed testimonial content only, with no rate, network or email visible on the page itself. No earnings-cap statement was found on any fetched page, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

UpPromote's directory states the program runs on CJ Affiliate and pays a flat $30 per annual membership sale and $5 per monthly membership sale; Lasso quotes a $5-$40 per-sale range. Because pay is a flat bounty rather than a percentage, commission_rate is recorded as null.

Beacons Universe reports posts from 498 creators all time (26 in the last 30 days), 103 sponsored posts in the last 12 months and 309 public posts in the last 12 months — a mid-size creator footprint, not low in absolute terms, so saturation is recorded as unknown.
Referly's program listing describes Thrive Market as a membership-based online grocery retailer focused on organic, non-GMO and eco-friendly products with over 1.7 million members.

reasons.niche_fit: Online grocery and healthy pantry staples fit food, wellness and family creator content well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 498 creators all time and 103 sponsored posts in 12 months on Beacons show an active affiliate channel.
reasons.compensation: Flat bounty of $30 per annual membership ($5 monthly) per directory listings — solid per-conversion pay, but not a percentage rate.
reasons.contact_access: Only a general member-services email (help@thrivemarket.com) was published on fetched pages.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Official affiliate page plus CJ listing make the program easy to find and join.

name: Viome
description: Bellevue, Washington health company founded in 2016 by Naveen Jain, selling at-home health tests that use RNA sequencing to deliver personalized nutrition and supplement recommendations.

evidence.summary: Viome's official affiliate page ('Join the Viome Affiliate Program') publishes an 8% commission, a 30-day cookie and last-touch attribution, and its sign-up button links to app.impact.com. No earnings-cap statement appears on the page, so the cap is recorded as unknown. An older directory listing claiming 15% conflicts with the official page and was not used.
Viome's own blog states the company has its corporate headquarters in Bellevue and was founded by serial entrepreneur Naveen Jain in 2016.
CB Insights describes Viome as an at-home health testing and personalized nutrition company founded in 2016 and based in Bellevue, Washington.

reasons.niche_fit: Gut health and personalized nutrition are strong, growing health-creator topics.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Official program page plus reported celebrity influencer partnerships, though no creator counts are published.
reasons.compensation: 8% commission published on the official page with a 30-day cookie; high test prices lift per-sale value.
reasons.contact_access: Direct application on the official page, but no published program email was found.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open sign-up on the brand's own site via Impact.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2016 by Naveen Jain, Bellevue-based, established at-home testing brand.

name: Wildwonder
description: San Francisco functional beverage brand launched in 2020 by founder Rosa Li, making sparkling prebiotic and probiotic drinks inspired by herbal tonics, with real fruit and low sugar; ships within the US only.

evidence.summary: Wildwonder's official FAQ has an Affiliate section directing creators to 'reach out via our affiliate page or contact support for program details and application steps', and publishes hello@drinkwildwonder.com for support. No rate or cap statement appears on the official pages fetched, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
LinkClicky's program listing states wildwonder uses the ShareASale affiliate platform, pays 15% commission per sale and runs a 90-day cookie, with the application link pointing to shareasale.com.

The official FAQ describes wildwonder as a sparkling prebiotic + probiotic beverage inspired by herbal wisdom and California fruit, crafted with real fruit, functional botanicals and low sugar, and states the brand currently ships within the US only.
BevNET reported the San Francisco-based brand's 2020 launch and its nationwide Sprouts rollout in 2022, supporting retail credibility.

reasons.niche_fit: Functional sparkling drinks are a proven beverage-creator niche with colorful, demo-friendly product.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An official affiliate route exists, but no creator counts or campaign data were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: 15% per sale with a 90-day cookie per the ShareASale listing — above the beverage norm.
reasons.contact_access: Published general email hello@drinkwildwonder.com plus an FAQ affiliate route.
reasons.opportunity_availability: ShareASale application is open; program details require sign-up to view.
reasons.credibility: Launched 2020, San Francisco-based, national Sprouts distribution reported by BevNET.

name: Ka'Chava
description: Plant-based superfood meal-replacement shake brand blending plant proteins, fibre, vitamins and minerals into an all-in-one nutrition shake; Beacons lists the brand as based in Boulder, United States.

evidence.summary: Lasso's Ka'Chava (US) program page states a 9.6% per-sale commission with a 30-day cookie and links joining to FlexOffers, while a WhichProgram topic listing states 20% with a 30-day cookie on ShareASale. The two published figures conflict with no official rate page to settle them, so commission_rate is recorded as null and flagged for re-confirmation at sign-up. No cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

Ka'Chava's official support page documents a separate referral program (give $15, get $15) and publishes support@kachava.com; its 'no limit' wording covers rewards points only, not affiliate earnings, so it is not treated as an uncapped-commission statement.

Beacons Universe reports posts from 206 creators all time (31 in the last 30 days), 189 sponsored posts in the last 12 months and 230 public posts in the last 12 months — a real but mid-size footprint, not clearly low in absolute terms, so saturation is recorded as unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: All-in-one meal shakes sit squarely in the wellness and fitness-food creator niche.
reasons.ugc_evidence: 206 creators and 189 sponsored posts in 12 months on Beacons show steady affiliate activity.
reasons.compensation: Published listings conflict (9.6% via FlexOffers vs 20% via ShareASale), so no single rate is recorded; either figure is workable.
reasons.contact_access: Published support email on the official support site; joining runs through network listings.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Program is listed on two networks with application required.
reasons.credibility: Established DTC shake brand with national sports-partnership visibility; founding details come from secondary sources.

name: Transparent Labs
description: American Fork, Utah sports-nutrition brand selling pre-workout, whey protein, creatine and fat burners with fully disclosed formulas, no proprietary blends and third-party testing.

evidence.summary: Beacons Universe reports posts from only 113 creators all time (21 in the last 30 days) and just 10 sponsored posts in the last 12 months, with 520 public posts in 12 months — a small absolute creator footprint for a national supplement brand, so creator saturation is recorded as low.

Afflemi's program profile states the TL Partners affiliate program pays 10% commission on every new referral order with a 30-day cookie, paid monthly by PayPal, and that applications are reviewed; a WhichProgram listing for the brand's Impact program states 30% with a 60-day cookie. The figures conflict by track, so the 10% TL Partners rate is recorded and the conflict flagged for re-confirmation. No cap statement was found, so the cap is unknown.

WhichProgram lists Transparent Labs' affiliate program on impact.com for the United States with application required, and describes its range as sports nutrition including creatine, pre-workout and electrolyte products.

reasons.niche_fit: Sports nutrition is a core fitness-creator niche and the range covers pre-workout, protein and creatine content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Only 113 creators all time on Beacons and a named Performance Partners group show a small, curated program.
reasons.compensation: 10% on new referral orders per the TL Partners profile; a separate Impact listing claims 30%, so confirm at sign-up.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email was found; contact runs through the application.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are reviewed rather than instant, which limits but does not close access.
reasons.credibility: Established Utah supplement brand known for label transparency and third-party testing.

name: Chomps
description: Meat-snack brand started in 2012 by Pete Maldonado and Rashid Ali and headquartered in Florida, selling grass-fed beef, venison and antibiotic-free turkey meat sticks with no added sugar or artificial ingredients.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's Chomps listing states the program runs on Impact and pays 10% commission per sale and 15% per recurring subscription; Lasso corroborates a 10% per-sale base rate with a 30-day cookie. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
An archived Chomps brand email invites readers to apply for its affiliate program and to reach out to marketing@chomps.com for more information, confirming both the program and a published contact.

Chomps' official brand story says the company was started in 2012 by Pete Maldonado and Rashid Ali, references its Florida headquarters, and states all meat sticks are made from grass-fed and finished beef and venison and antibiotic-free turkey.

reasons.niche_fit: High-protein snacks fit fitness, family and on-the-go food content well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Affiliate program is documented on network listings, but no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: 10% per sale and 15% on recurring subscriptions per the Impact listing — the subscription uplift is attractive.
reasons.contact_access: Published marketing@chomps.com address from the brand's own affiliate invitation email.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Joining runs through Impact; no standalone brand affiliate page was found.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2012 with national retail presence and a Florida HQ.

name: Therabody
description: Los Angeles wellness-technology company founded in 2016 by Dr. Jason Wersland, known for Theragun percussive therapy devices and other recovery, sleep and skincare products.

evidence.summary: LinkClicky's Therabody listing states the affiliate program runs on Impact and pays 5% commission per sale; FlexOffers' program page corroborates that publishers earn 5% commission on online sales. No earnings-cap statement was found, so the cap is recorded as unknown.
FlexOffers hosts a Therabody affiliate program page stating publishers can earn a 5% commission on online sales, giving creators a second network route into the same program.
RetailMeNot's brand page notes Therabody offers an affiliate program for professionals and influencers, supporting the program's creator relevance.

reasons.niche_fit: Recovery devices are a staple of fitness, wellness and sports creator content, with high demo value.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Program is explicitly open to professionals and influencers per RetailMeNot, though no creator counts are published.
reasons.compensation: 5% per sale is modest, partly offset by Theragun's high average order value.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email was found; joining is via network listings only.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Listed on both Impact and FlexOffers, so application routes are easy to find.
reasons.credibility: Founded 2016 in Los Angeles by Dr. Jason Wersland; category-defining Theragun brand.
